!["Discord link to the "LopyMine's Project" discord server](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/21f178aff2b64844fefeaf94a3a3a418440fd43f.png)](https://discord.gg/NZzxdkrV4s) [![Github Link-Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d87060a9e4522786e45b4b54d10853a1b4a91b10.png)](https://github.com/LopyMine/Inventory-Particles) [![Support Link-Banner [Boosty]](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dce91fef079649dee277c52a998fc068e745e99e.png)](https://boosty.to/lopymine/donate) [![CurseForge Link-Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c39affcb732c8b1a4fe189e79898c686da3d63e2.png)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/inventory-particles) [![Modrinth Link-Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9991553f6a20e5105b9b153b8d817bc3630c18a8.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/inventory-particles) !["描述"標題](https://github.com/LopyMine/Profile/blob/main/files/Template%20Resource%20Pack/image2.webp?raw=true) **Inventory Particles** —— 一款視覺效果模組，為您的物品欄物品增添了大量全新的粒子特效！使用它，您可以讓您的物品欄變得更加生動活潑、充滿動態感！當然，這完全是客戶端運行的。 ![遊戲內展示](https://github.com/LopyMine/Profile/blob/main/files/Template%20Resource%20Pack/ima222ge.webp?raw=true) ![標籤「超過 1300 種紋理、超過 800 個區域、超過 400 個設定檔」](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b31510bc5bff1c5c150a1aadb6a317e220882f6c.png) ![此處僅供裝飾](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e66456118e8d1bd51d25bd166f33d70e008a0fe6_0.webp) !["相容性"標題](https://github.com/LopyMine/Profile/blob/main/files/Template%20Resource%20Pack/compatiblev2.webp?raw=true) 您可能會好奇這個模組是如何處理來自其他模組的物品呢？從 **v2.0.0** 版本開始，該模組引入了**專有的「家族」粒子生成系統！** **您完全不需要手動設定——模組會為您自動處理所有事項！** **簡而言之：** 模組內建了設定檔，用於定義物品的「類別」與「種類」。它會分析物品，並根據這些設定檔分配粒子、調整顏色，以及為物品本身設定獨特的生成區域。
家族設定範例 ```json { "keywords": [ "powder", "gunpowder", "sugar", "dust", "dye", "ash", "ashen" ], "tags": [ "c:dusts" ], "particles": [ { "id": "family/dust/dust", "textures": [ "inventory_particles:dust/dust_0.png", "inventory_particles:dust/dust_1.png", "inventory_particles:dust/dust_2.png" ], "texture_generation_mode": { "luminance": true, "saturation": true, "frequency": true }, "spawn_count": [0, 2], "spawn_frequency": [10, 20], "speed_coefficient": 0.25, "nbt_conditions_match": "any", "nbt_conditions": [] } ], "family_groups": [], "compatible": false, "priority": 1500 } ```
![此處僅供裝飾](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e66456118e8d1bd51d25bd166f33d70e008a0fe6_0.webp) !["可自訂性"標題](https://github.com/LopyMine/Profile/blob/main/files/Template%20Resource%20Pack/image.webp?raw=true) Inventory Particles 中的**所有粒子**皆採用**資料驅動**設計！這意味著您只需透過資源包和基礎設定檔，即可新增更多粒子效果！ **您可以自訂以下項目：** 1) 物理特性（加速度、減速、衝量等） 2) 旋轉（實際位移與視覺旋轉） 3) 大小（含動畫） 4) 顏色（含動畫） 5) 紋理（含動畫） 6) 來源物品（觸發生成的物品） 7) 生成區域（僅需額外紋理） 8) 存在時間（刻/ticks） 9) 以及其他細微設定 ^^ [**請參閱官方維基以了解運作方式！**](https://github.com/LopyMine/Inventory-Particles/wiki)
設定檔範例 ```json { "life_time": 100, "animation_type": "stretch", "animation_speed": 1.0, "size": { "width": 8.0, "height": 8.0 }, // or "size": { // https://nicmulvaney.com/easing "interpolation": "ease_in_quint", "sizes": { "0": { "width": 16.0, "height": 16.0, // Overrides "ease_in_quint" "interpolation": "linear" }, "50": { "width": 32.0, "height": 32.0 }, "100": { "width": 64.0, "height": 64.0 } } }, "textures": [ "inventory-particles:example/texture_0.png", "inventory-particles:example/texture_1.png" ], "holders": [ { "item": "minecraft:potion", "spawn_area": "example_spawn_area.png", "spawn_count": [0, 1], "spawn_frequency": [5, 20], "speed_coefficient": 0.3, "color": "#AARRGGBB", // or "color": { // mixed, random, random_static, gradient, gradient_random_static, gradient_loop, gradient_bounce "mode": "gradient", "values": ["#FF8CC091", "#003700", "nbt", "nbt_list"], "speed": 5.0 }, "nbt_conditions_match": "none", "nbt_conditions": [ { "this_name": "components", "this_type": "object", "next_match": "any", "next": { "this_name": "minecraft:potion_contents", "this_type": "object", "next_match": "any", "next": [ { "this_name": "potion", "this_type": "string", "check_value": "minecraft:water" } ] } } ] } ], "physics": { "base": { "x_speed": { "impulse": [0.0, 0.0], "impulse_bidirectional": false, "acceleration": 0.0, "acceleration_bidirectional": false, "max_acceleration": [-100.0, 100.0], "braking": 0.0, "turbulence": [0.0, 0.0], "cursor_impulse_inherit_coefficient": 1.0 }, "y_speed": { "impulse": [0.0, 0.0], "impulse_bidirectional": false, "acceleration": 0.0, "acceleration_bidirectional": false, "max_acceleration": [-100.0, 100.0], "braking": 0.0, "turbulence": [0.0, 0.0], "cursor_impulse_inherit_coefficient": 1.0 }, "angle_speed": { "impulse": [1.0, 1.5], "impulse_bidirectional": false, "acceleration": 0.0, "acceleration_bidirectional": false, "max_acceleration": [-100.0, 100.0], "braking": 0.0, "turbulence": [0.0, 0.0] } }, "rotation": { "particle": { "spawn_angle": [0.0, 360.0], "rotate_in_movement_direction": false, "speed": { "impulse": [0.0, 0.0], "impulse_bidirectional": false, "acceleration": 0.0, "acceleration_bidirectional": false, "max_acceleration": 0.0, "braking": 0.0, "turbulence": [0.0, 0.0] } }, "texture": { "spawn_angle": [0.0, 0.0], "rotate_in_movement_direction": false, "speed": { "impulse": [0.0, 0.0], "impulse_bidirectional": true, "acceleration": 0.0, "acceleration_bidirectional": false, "max_acceleration": 0.0, "braking": 0.0, "turbulence": [0.0, 0.0] } } } } } ```
![此處僅供裝飾](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e66456118e8d1bd51d25bd166f33d70e008a0fe6_0.webp) ![展示](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c681a00eaa95d93c03b28566a266f2aad3707e5f.png) ### ![Icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9111988448f778aaff9ac4477e463343fe4dc7e4.png) 想支援本模組與作者嗎？只要向其他人推薦這款模組就好！ 沒錯，您沒看錯。光是透過宣傳推薦，就能實質地支持模組與創作者。知道這款模組的人越多，下載量就會越高；更多的下載量能給予作者極大的動力，並增加網站上的收入（純粹是免費的贊助）。**請記住，宣傳絕不可過於打擾或令人反感！** ### 您可以做什麼？ - 製作影片評測／廣告宣傳 - 將此模組分享給您的朋友 - 直接下載體驗此模組（如果您想親自嘗試的話 :D） # 📑 授權條款 [**請查看原始模組儲存庫。**](https://github.com/LopyMine/Inventory-Particles)
